coverage.method: Every EN/ZH pair presented side by side in sorted batches 1-150, 151-225, 226-300, 301-375, 376-450, 451-525, 526-600, 601-675, 676-750, 751-825, 826-895; every omitted pair span expanded from its tool spill. Linguistic judgement is independent, not inferred from key parity or mechanical score. Available context sidecar, locale style guide, glossary, source pin, author receipt, current postauthor manifest/cache and targeted consumer definitions consulted.

changed_labels_verdict.reason: 询问 is an ordinary concise prompting-mode label; 自动 is the ordinary Chinese automatic-mode label. Neither says all tools always prompt, allow all, unconditional permission or guardrail bypass. Existing write/exec descriptions and process-local loosening help retain the proper scope. Choice.value ask/auto remains separate in settings_io.py:3368-3406; this is a source/copy audit, not a runtime gate exercise.

namespace_verdict.reason: 32 human selector labels remain untranslated English. They are independently localizable display fields, not required model-facing text. Do not declare full namespace native approval. The small changed-label scope is clean; inherited programme gaps must be batched or separately owned, not misattributed to these two new labels.

controls.pseudo_check: Scanned all 895 target values for pseudo wrappers; no artifacts. No pseudo-locale app or renderer was run. Literal ICU quoting was parsed/rendered on all values.
controls.unit_review: Human byte/s/ms/hour/day/token/MB/MiB/GiB units inspected in all pairs. 55k is faithfully 55000; byte units remain binary where source specifies binary; monitor.classifyMaxChars helper has a minor human unit ambiguity (T-ZH-A-041), not a wire-unit change.
controls.register: No 您 occurs; 你 address form is consistent. Turn terminology drift 轮次 vs 回合 is reported.

overflow.method: Unicode East Asian Width cell estimate; no material expansion candidates under +8 cells absolute, and no labels >=1.5x English with >=4-cell growth. Changed Chinese labels are 4 cells each. This does not prove actual renderer fit.

legitimate_english_exceptions.reason: Named products/providers/agents/default agent display names, not generic untranslated prose.

Three provider IDs openrouter/radient/typesafe, named compaction mechanisms context-full/snapcompact, OpenAI API names chat_completions/responses, Python stdlib backend identifier and glossary-prescribed endpoint; unlike auto/manual/default/female, these identify actual named technical choices.
Explicit shared glossary kept-English set; surrounding prose translated.

Named cmux object or networking/format/protocol/developer tokens and exact time-format examples; not a blanket exception for English labels. LLM token stays token per Chinese guide; authentication tokens are 令牌.

Commands, flags, config paths/keys, owner/repo and host:port forms, environment variables, code snippets, tool identifiers, API cleanup field and literal raw enum values quoted in API explanations stay exact. No model-facing .default keys occur in this 895-key map; none were translated by reflex.

findings.english: Needs Highlights on. Files named before the rest fold into 'N more'.
findings.current: 需开启亮点。先点名的文件之外的其余文件折叠为'N more'。
findings.proposed: 需开启亮点。超出显示数量的其余文件会折叠显示为“另有N个”。
findings.reason: The quoted N more is user-visible UI wording, not a command or model token; keeping it English leaves a localization gap.
CoS is an unexplained English abbreviation for the same role already labelled 幕僚长 in this namespace.

findings.english: Local wall-clock HH:MM. An invalid value falls back to 08:30 at the next arm.
findings.current: 本地壁钟时间HH:MM。无效值会在下次调度时回退为08:30。
findings.proposed: 本地时间，格式为HH:MM。值无效时，下次安排定时任务会回退到08:30。
findings.reason: 本地壁钟时间 is a literal calque; the sibling Librarian setting already uses the idiomatic 本地时间 for the same wall-clock concept.

findings.english: Retry a failed provider call before surfacing the error.
findings.current: 提供商调用失败时先重试，再浮现错误。
findings.proposed: 提供商调用失败时先重试，再显示错误。
findings.reason: 浮现错误 is an English surfacing calque rather than natural Chinese UI wording.

findings.english: Wake to check in on projects whose progress went stale. Settled (done/paused/archived) projects are never watched.
findings.current: 项目进度停滞时唤醒去检查。已结项（done/paused/archived）的项目从不监视。
findings.proposed: 项目进度停滞时唤醒去检查。已完成、已暂停或已归档（done/paused/archived）的项目从不监视。
findings.reason: 已结项 means completed/closed, whereas the English explicitly also excludes paused projects; the raw state identifiers are preserved technical tokens but do not make the Chinese collective label accurate.

findings.english: summary, a short resume card and a recent tail; earlier turns not verbatim
findings.current: 摘要、简短的恢复卡片和最近的尾部；较早轮次不逐字保留
findings.proposed: 摘要、简短的恢复卡片和最近的记录；较早回合不逐字保留
findings.reason: 轮次 drifts from 回合 used for the same English turn throughout nearby settings, and 最近的尾部 is a literal tail calque.

findings.english: summary, every preserved user turn and the kept window
findings.current: 摘要、每个保留的用户轮次和保留窗口
findings.proposed: 摘要、每个保留的用户回合和保留窗口
findings.reason: The same English turn is rendered 轮次 here but 回合 in the surrounding compaction controls; use the established term.

findings.english: What a resumed session replays after a compaction. Card is far smaller, but earlier operator turns no longer survive verbatim, and switching back to full does not restore them.
findings.current: 压缩后恢复的会话重放哪些内容。卡片小得多，但操作员较早的轮次不再逐字保留，切换回完整也无法恢复。
findings.proposed: 压缩后恢复的会话重放哪些内容。卡片小得多，但操作员较早的回合不再逐字保留，切换回完整也无法恢复。
findings.reason: The English turn is rendered 轮次 here but 回合 in the surrounding compaction controls; this is glossary drift, not a different concept.

findings.english: Bound on the changed lines the materiality check receives (the monitor's name and purpose ride along, clipped separately).
findings.current: 重要性检查可接收的变更行上限（监控名称与用途一同传入，单独截断）。
findings.proposed: 重要性检查可接收的变更文本字符数上限（监控名称与用途一同传入，单独截断）。
findings.reason: 变更行上限 can be read as a line-count limit, while the adjacent label and monitor.classifyMaxChars setting define a character cap; make the human unit explicit.
